study type: secondary analysis of a prospective, observational cohort study
exposure: Periconceptional diet quality (assessed using the Alternative Healthy Eating Index (AHEI)-2010)
outcome: Glucose concentrations from GDM screening and diagnostic tests
cohort: This study included 7997 nulliparous participants from the NuMoM2b study.
finding: Poor periconceptional diet quality was independently associated with an increased risk of GDM and with minor elevations in serum glucose concentrations on GDM screening and diagnostic tests.
